description: This file defines the class DefaultPolicyCommandAdapterProvider, which implements PolicyCommandAdapterProvider. It provides and manages various Adapter instances for handling Policy-related commands, responses, and errors within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter’s policies module.

classes.name: DefaultPolicyCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: A final class implementing PolicyCommandAdapterProvider that provides adapters for various Policy commands and responses, managing their lifecycle and aggregation.

methods.name: DefaultPolicyCommandAdapterProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes adapter instances using provided ErrorRegistry and HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getErrorResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for handling PolicyErrorResponse.

methods.name: getModifyCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for handling PolicyModifyCommand.

methods.name: getModifyCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for handling PolicyModifyCommandResponse.

methods.name: getQueryCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for handling PolicyQueryCommand.

methods.name: getQueryCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for handling PolicyQueryCommandResponse.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns a list of all adapters managed by this provider.
